services.desc: Is it a rainy day with nothing to do? Are you looking to shake things up this weekend? Come to Eye Spy Escape Room in Abilene, TX for an excursion in Doc Savage’s Exam Room. This thrilling escape room comes with a dark twist - finding your way out before you’re taken into the wrong procedure. Make sure you only bring your closest friends and family, as their help or sabotage can affect the final outcome. You’ve just entered the world of Doc Savage’s exam room. A world in which his medical procedures are starting to be questioned and patients are being scheduled for the wrong ones - including you.
